title: Is this savings app worth it?

flags.title: Referral link is not clearly disclosed
flags.evidence: You say "use my link in bio for ₹250 cashback", and #affiliate only appears at the end of 14 hashtags.

citation.title: Guidelines for Influencer Advertising in Digital Media

sourceQuote.text: Disclosure should not be buried in a group of hashtags or links.

flags.suggestedFix: Say "this is my affiliate link, I earn a commission" before you mention it, and start your caption with "Affiliate".

flags.title: Returns are presented as guaranteed
flags.evidence: "You will earn a guaranteed 12% a year, better than any FD" promises a return the app does not guarantee.

citation.title: The ASCI Code, Chapter I: Truthful and honest representation

sourceQuote.text: Advertisements inviting the public to invest money shall not contain statements which may mislead the consumer in respect of the security offered, rates of return or terms of amortisation

flags.suggestedFix: Quote the app's current rate, say it can change, and drop "guaranteed".

flags.title: Screenshot is cropped above the fees line
flags.evidence: The plans screen is cut off just above "₹99 a month", so the plan looks free.

citation.title: The ASCI Code, Chapter I: Truthful and honest representation

sourceQuote.text: Advertisements shall not contain statements or visual presentation, which directly, or by implication or by omission or by ambiguity or by exaggeration, are likely to mislead the consumer about the product advertised

flags.suggestedFix: Show the full plans screen, or say the ₹99 monthly fee out loud.

flags.title: News clip used without credit
flags.evidence: A 6 second clip from a TV business segment appears without naming the channel.
flags.suggestedFix: Add an on-screen credit for the channel, or replace the clip with your own footage.

flags.title: Deposit insurance covers ₹5 lakh, not ₹10 lakh
flags.evidence: You say "your money here is insured up to ₹10 lakh". DICGC insures bank deposits up to ₹5 lakh per depositor in a bank, and the app itself is not a bank.

sourceQuote.text: Each depositor in a bank is insured upto a maximum of ₹ 5,00,000 (Rupees Five Lakhs) for both principal and interest
sourceQuote.source: DICGC FAQs, "What is the maximum deposit amount insured by the DICGC?"

flags.suggestedFix: Say "deposits at the partner bank are insured up to ₹5 lakh by DICGC" and name the bank.

flags.title: The ₹500 note claim was fact-checked before
flags.evidence: You repeat that "RBI is pulling ₹500 notes from ATMs". PIB Fact Check called this message fake in July 2025.

citation.title: PIB Fact Check: Has the RBI asked banks to stop dispensing ₹500 notes from ATMs by September?

sourceQuote.text: has debunked this claim, confirming that the RBI has not issued any such instruction
sourceQuote.source: Angel One, reporting PIB Fact Check, 14 July 2025

flags.suggestedFix: Cut the line, or say it was a viral rumour that PIB Fact Check debunked.

flags.title: Not enough evidence for "users save ₹2,000 a month"
flags.evidence: We couldn't find an independent source for this number. It only appears in the app's own ads.
flags.suggestedFix: Attribute it ("the company says") or leave it out.

flags.title: No one can guarantee stock market returns
flags.evidence: SEBI warns that there can be no guarantee of assured returns in the securities market.

citation.title: SEBI cautions public against dealing with unregistered entities (PR No. 2/2024)

sourceQuote.text: there can be no guarantees of assured returns in the securities market
sourceQuote.source: SEBI press release PR No. 2/2024, 13 February 2024

flags.title: Fund tip may need your SEBI registration number
flags.evidence: You name a small-cap fund and say "start your SIP here". If that counts as investment advice, ASCI expects your SEBI registration number up front. We could not confirm the clause applies to this line.

citation.title: Guidelines for Influencer Advertising in Digital Media

flags.suggestedFix: If you're SEBI registered, show your registration number at the start. If not, keep it general and don't name a fund.
